findings.motion: H. 5500 (FY2027 budget), on adoption of amendment #1587, An Act relative to identification to vote (Lombardo)
findings.note: Roll call No. 174 lists Fluker-Reid as N. The amendment would require a valid government-issued photo ID to receive a ballot at the polls, and would have the Secretary of the Commonwealth provide a free photo ID card to any registered voter without one who signs an affidavit. It was rejected 27 yeas to 131 nays. The text is at https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H5500/1587/House/Content and the Beacon Hill Roll Call report at https://recorder.com/2026/05/08/beacon-hill-roll-call-april-27-to-may-1-2026/ says a No vote is against requiring voters to present an ID.
subjects: free state photo ID for voting

findings.motion: H. 4000 (FY2026 budget), on adoption of amendment #409, An Act relative to identification to vote (Lombardo)
findings.note: Roll call No. 42 lists Fluker-Reid as N. Amendment #409 to H4000 has the same opening text as the 2026 amendment, rewriting G.L. c. 54 s. 76 on voter check-in at the polls to require photo identification. It was rejected 25 yeas to 131 nays. Amendment text at https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H4000/409/House/Content
